title: Open Weather Dashboard
description: A real-time weather dashboard with interactive charts, 7-day forecasts, and location search. Consumes the OpenWeatherMap API with client-side caching.

title: Markdown Note Sync
description: Browser-based markdown editor that syncs notes to localStorage with real-time preview, syntax highlighting, and export to PDF or HTML.

title: Pixel Palette
description: In-browser pixel art editor with a 64×64 canvas, custom colour palettes, animation frame support, and export to PNG or GIF.

title: Recipe Finder
description: Search over 1 million recipes by ingredients, dietary restrictions, and cuisine. Saves favourites to a shareable URL via base64-encoded state.

title: CLI Task Runner
description: A zero-dependency task runner for Go projects. Reads a YAML manifest and executes tasks with dependency resolution, parallel execution, and colour output.

title: Budget Lens
description: Personal finance tracker that parses bank CSV exports and visualises spending trends with D3.js charts. All data stays in the browser.
